question: Does the fixed nine-point calibration map the 32 unchanged coordinate challenges to their certified-anchor target Kummer values exactly?

claims.text: The frozen matrix agrees projectively on all 32 preselected coordinate inputs and their successors in this one public toy case.
No inverse transfer, global section identity, Profile B initialization, speedup or security claim is established by this phase.

arms.description: Frozen M times the first eight native source quotient sections; no reference labels or target arithmetic.
Validation-only native divisor arithmetic from the certified anchor with the exact fixed origin.
Three historical F49 vectors checked through both direct and residue-algebra paths.
Frozen source coordinate vectors with entries zero and one swapped after calibration.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Deterministic exact algebra; no noisy or comparative metric.

positive.expected_detection: All three historical F49 Kummer vectors match; direct six-permutation and residue-algebra evaluations agree.

null_population.description: The same 32 frozen coordinate vectors with entries zero and one swapped after matrix freeze.
null_population.generator: Deterministic declared permutation of each unchanged source coordinate vector.
null_population.why_n: Exactly the parent's fixed challenge suite, without selection or replacement.

factors.name: case
factors.how: Unchanged parent manifest and public target hashes.

factors.name: origin
factors.how: Section-space divisor arithmetic; no arbitrary generator or alternate origin.

factors.name: inputs
factors.how: Copy the already frozen coordinate envelope; labels are validation-only after matrix freeze.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: One locked native build, source hashes and one thread; exact primary metrics only.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Record host and resource diagnostics; clocks do not decide a result.

comparisons.threshold: 32/32 exact primary and successor identities; permutation control not 32/32

variable_ledger.aa_not_applicable: Exact finite identities, not a statistical or performance comparison.

transfer_obligations.scope: Only the Kummer calibration gate; inverse/sign/class-group transfer requirements remain in the parent protocol.

randomization.arm_order_reason: First freeze the calibration matrix, then publish evaluator predictions, then open the validation-only oracle.

seed_derivation.note: The parent manifest's SHA256 coordinate stream is already frozen; no new seed or point choice.

instance_sampling.rule: Use all 32 existing case IDs and P+G partners unchanged.

blinding.how: Exact identities, not subjective/statistical analysis. Reference labels and targets stay outside the evaluator and are computed only after matrix publication.

power.note: An exact requirement on the complete declared finite suite; no probabilistic generality claim or significance test.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: No target data taken yet. Parent bound is 3600 wall seconds and 2 GiB; timeout is inconclusive and preserved.

primary.name: Exact projective matches
primary.definition: Count cross-product equality for every fixed primary input; record all failed cases.

secondary.name: Successor matches
secondary.definition: Exact matches for the corresponding 32 fixed P+G inputs.

stopping_rules.rule: Stop on a failed chart, control, rank or field check; retain the input and failure. Do not replace any training/challenge input.
Freeze the matrix before opening target challenge values; record all 32 failures/matches and stop dependent inversion on any mismatch.
At most 3600 wall seconds and 2 GiB address space for this experimental pipeline.

decision_rule.text: Pass only if the fixed matrix matches all 32 primary and all 32 successor vectors, with historical controls passing and the swapped suite failing. A failed feasibility gate is not a refutation of the global construction.
decision_rule.threshold: 32/32 primaries and successors; swapped-coordinate pass count below 32
decision_rule.interval: Not applicable to exact finite equalities
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Number of exact matches out of the fixed 32

inadmissible: Replace or omit a frozen point
Use source labels or expected targets in the evaluator
Claim divisor inversion or Profile B from calibration
Use diagnostic clocks as a speed claim

literature.claim: Origin, symmetric Kummer sections and fixed linear coordinate change; no novelty claim.
Section-space representations and exact multiplication/division, with degree hypotheses checked.
Unchanged certified anchor, charts, section basis and source/challenge freeze.
literature.verified_by: Read and hash-bind the pinned historical reports.
